initial_prompt: Write a short, whimsical poem about a robot who loves to garden. Don't explain your process, just write the poem.

messages.content: Write a short, whimsical poem about a robot who loves to garden. Don't explain your process, just write the poem.

Unit Four-B with a thumb of chrome,
Decided to make the dirt his home.
He traded his laser for trowel and seed,
To nurture the soil and pull every weed.

With a little oil drip and a solar beam,
He hums a low-voltage, happy theme.
Though he cannot eat carrots or smell the sweet phlox,
He’s the happiest bot in the flower box.
